# truenas_periodic_snapshot_task (Resource)

Manages a periodic snapshot task on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_dataset" "mydata" {
  name = "tank/mydata"
}

resource "truenas_periodic_snapshot_task" "daily" {
  # Reference the dataset by name rather than hardcoding "tank/mydata", so
  # Terraform creates the dataset before the task that snapshots it (a
  # hardcoded name gives no dependency edge and can fail on the first apply).
  dataset        = truenas_dataset.mydata.name
  recursive      = true
  lifetime_value = 2
  lifetime_unit  = "WEEK"
  naming_schema  = "auto-%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M"
  enabled        = true

  schedule {
    minute = "0"
    hour   = "0"
    dom    = "*"
    month  = "*"
    dow    = "*"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) Dataset path to snapshot.
- `lifetime_unit` (String) HOUR, DAY, WEEK, MONTH, or YEAR.
- `lifetime_value` (Number)
- `naming_schema` (String) Snapshot naming pattern, e.g. "auto-%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M".
- `schedule` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))

### Optional

- `allow_empty` (Boolean)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `exclude` (List of String)
- `recursive` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `dom` (String) Day of month.
- `dow` (String) Day of week.
- `hour` (String) Cron hour.
- `minute` (String) Cron minute (e.g. 0, */15).
- `month` (String) Month.
